issue: No hover tooltip on dependency connector line
actual: The dashed vertical connector segments (class bg-dashed-line) rendered between dependency-chain tasks (task1→task4→task7) are plain non-interactive divs with no title/aria attributes or event listeners. Hovering over them (isolated from any other element) produces no popup/tooltip element in the DOM (checked for [role=tooltip], radix popper wrapper, .popover, [class*=tooltip] — none appeared).
evidence: Hovering #test-dashed-0 (the connector between 'Review project proposal' and 'Complete tax filing') yields zero tooltip elements, while hovering the blocked-warning label on the same task does produce a tooltip.

Hovering [data-semtag-id='tasks.list.item.4.blocked-warning'] (Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete) reveals a tooltip with text "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal / pending", correctly identifying the pending prerequisite.

issue: Edit control fully disabled on blocked task instead of allowing partial edit
actual: For blocked task 'Complete tax filing' (tasks.list.item.4), the Edit button is rendered with the disabled attribute (pointer-events:none, opacity 50%) and cannot be clicked (Playwright click timed out: 'element is not enabled'). There is no alternate inline control for editing description or priority — clicking the priority badge directly does nothing. So a blocked task's description and priority cannot be modified at all, contradicting the requirement that only title/deadline should be locked while description/priority remain editable.
evidence: button[disabled] data-semtag-id='tasks.list.item.4.edit'; click attempt timed out with 'element is not enabled'.

Blocked tasks (task4, task7) render with distinct styling (bg-muted/30, border-dashed border-warning/40) vs normal cards, and their complete toggle button is disabled (button[disabled]) until prerequisites complete.
task4 (single prerequisite) shows 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; task7 (multiple prerequisites) shows '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

While task1 was incomplete, task4's complete toggle was disabled. After completing task1, task4's complete/edit became enabled and its blocked-warning disappeared (state changed active/blocked appropriately), confirming eligibility gating on prerequisite completion.

Created task with title 'Plan team offsite', description 'Book venue and send invites for the Q3 offsite.', deadline 2026-09-15, priority High, prerequisites [Buy groceries, Complete tax filing]. New card shows exactly: 'Plan team offsite / High / Book venue and send invites for the Q3 offsite. / Sep 15 / 2 prerequisites incomplete'.

Assigned 'Buy groceries' and 'Complete tax filing' as prerequisites of new task 'Plan team offsite' via the multi-select prerequisite checkboxes; saved task shows blocked state '2 prerequisites incomplete', correctly reflecting the dependency.
Created task with a non-empty title; active count increased from 4 to 5 (tasks.summary '5 active, 3 completed'), and the new task appears in the active-filtered list.
Typing whitespace-only text ('    ') into the title field keeps the Create Task submit button disabled (enabled:false); after cancelling, tasks.summary remains '5 active, 3 completed' unchanged.

Edited unblocked task 'Schedule dentist appointment' → changed title to 'Schedule dentist checkup', description, deadline to Sep 5, priority to Low, and added prerequisite 'Buy groceries'; card now reads 'Schedule dentist checkup / Low / Call Dr. Smith's office for annual checkup and cleaning. / Sep 5 / Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete', matching submitted values. Deleted task 'Plan team offsite': toast 'Task deleted - "Plan team offsite" has been removed', card removed from list, active count decreased 5→4.
Clicked complete toggle on eligible active task 'Buy groceries': it left the active list (active count 4→3), and now appears in the completed view (completed count 3→4) with toggle state 'completed'.

Active view (filters.show-active) shows only active-state tasks with count 3; switching to Completed view (filters.show-completed) shows exactly 4 completed tasks (Review project proposal, Reply to client emails, Buy groceries, Organize desk), each with completed toggle state, and both toggles/count reflect '3 active, 4 completed' in tasks.summary.

After marking 'Buy groceries' complete, it remained visible (not deleted) in the completed view with full details intact. Clicking its complete toggle again reopened it: it left the completed view (completed count 4→3) and reappeared in the active view (active count 3→4), confirming completion doesn't delete and reopening restores it to active.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its completed dependent simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Setup: task1 'Review project proposal' completed → task4 'Complete tax filing' (depends on task1) completed. Then reopened task1 (toggled it back to active) with no warning or prevention. Result: task4 remains listed under the Completed filter with toggle state 'completed' (semantic_observe: state='completed', enabled=false), yet it also now displays the blocking warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' and has its edit/complete actions disabled — i.e. it is simultaneously marked completed and blocked, which the system neither prevented (reopening task1 succeeded unconditionally) nor resolved (task4 was not reverted to an incomplete/active state).
evidence: tasks.list.item.4.complete → {"state":"completed","enabled":false}; card text: "Complete tax filing ... Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" while still under Completed 3 view.

Editing task1 'Review project proposal', which task4 'Complete tax filing' directly depends on and task7 'Submit final report' indirectly depends on, the prerequisite selection list only offers ['Schedule dentist checkup', 'Buy groceries', 'Organize desk', 'Reply to client emails'] — task4 and task7 (which would create direct/indirect cycles) are correctly omitted from the selectable options.

With Sort by = Priority, active view order is: 'Review project proposal'(High), 'Submit final report'(High), 'Test sort medium task'(Medium), 'Schedule dentist checkup'(Low), 'Buy groceries'(Low) — High before Medium before Low, as required.

With Sort by = Deadline, active view order was: 'Buy groceries'(Tomorrow/Aug26), 'Review project proposal'(Aug27), 'Submit final report'(Aug30), 'Schedule dentist checkup'(Sep5), 'Test sort medium task'(no deadline, last) — earliest first, no-deadline task placed after all dated tasks.

Every card shows title (heading) + priority badge. Description/deadline paragraphs render only when supplied ('Test sort medium task', created without description/deadline, shows only title+priority; other tasks with those fields show them). Blocking prerequisite state is exposed via the 'Prerequisite ... incomplete' warning label on blocked tasks. Completed tasks are visually distinguished: title has classes 'line-through text-muted-foreground' and card background is 'bg-muted/50 border-border/50' vs plain bg-card for active tasks.
